primary_decisions.title: Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures
primary_decisions.problem: 等比例双模态交互难以指导不等比例、重复受限的三模态训练。
primary_decisions.insight: 把跨模态迁移、共享容量竞争和各模态重复收益分开建模。
primary_decisions.method: 268-run fixed-family MoE grid, positive effective parameter/data transformations, repetition saturation, three unre-fitted validation runs.
primary_decisions.result: Eight of nine validation losses within 2.51%; text in the non-text-heavy continuation differs by 6.73%.
primary_decisions.limitation: 总参数包含非激活专家与embedding；视觉/音频验证loss含关联文本；主要单种子、固定tokenizer与架构；某些项并非在全部消融指标占优；继续预训练文本失败未被延长训练实证修复；15T示例仅外推。
primary_decisions.sections_read: Metadata/history; §§1–6, §9; Appendix G fit validation/ablations, H held-outs, I router interpretation. Not all appendices or visual plots.
primary_decisions.evidence_status: Primary metadata and selected sections; no independent reproduction, code audit or figure digitization.
primary_decisions.changes_existing_conclusion: Adds directional mixing and capacity/repetition coupling to T7; no universal coefficients or repetition cutoff.
evidence_notes: 6 total-parameter scales, 457M–8.3B, up to 150B tokens; fixed 16 routed experts/top-2 plus one shared.
Held-outs: scratch 12.6B A3.8B at 200B tokens; two 8.3B A2.6B continuations from 100B text.
No-transfer full-fit RMSE slightly better by 0.7%; worst error worse. Full model not uniformly best under every criterion.
Table 1 versus appendix unimodal vision exponent differs; no exact vision exponent adopted.
Text-to-vision aggregate sign depends on task: understanding text-token and image-generation fits differ.
Audio near-zero transfer is unstable across folds and does not remove its capacity cost.
Claimed NeurIPS spotlight is author metadata, not independently checked venue acceptance.

primary_decisions.title: More Than Seeing: Vision as Scalable Anchors in Native Multimodal Pre-Training
primary_decisions.problem: 改变多模态比例会同时改变文本监督和预算，难以归因视觉内容的作用。
primary_decisions.insight: 在相同数据顺序、长度、掩码和模型下，用无内容padding替换图像embedding。
primary_decisions.method: Six MoE activated non-embedding scales 71M–3B, fixed multimodal/text input-token ratio 0.3, smoothed training text loss; matched img/pad runs.
primary_decisions.result: Authors report nearly unchanged text frontiers and growing multimodal relative loss gaps, with selective text-only spatial transfer.
primary_decisions.limitation: 非无图像位置的text-only基线；325B含图像patch；训练loss代理非留出测试loss；同run两种拟合法非独立验证；空间收益不单调，不能推断普遍推理增益或超出测量范围的幂律。
primary_decisions.sections_read: Metadata/history; §§1–6 including methods, paired conditions and evaluation; appendix snippets only, no complete appendix/proof/code review.
primary_decisions.evidence_status: Primary metadata and selected sections; no independent reproduction, code audit or figure digitization.
primary_decisions.changes_existing_conclusion: Useful controlled-content complement; no new T7 body claim pending detailed evaluation and seed audit.
